plugins.name: Focus Timer
plugins.description: Give one important task a quiet, timed work session.
plugins.details: Choose a task, start a 15, 25 or 50 minute session, and pause when you need to. The timer keeps its finish time when you close and reopen the window. No tracking, notifications or network requests.
plugins.author: Theon

plugins.name: Scratchpad
plugins.description: Clear your head with a small, automatically saved writing space.
plugins.details: A distraction-free scratchpad for a rough thought or the next step in your work. Text saves as you type in this plugin’s own browser storage. Download a text copy when you want to keep it elsewhere.
plugins.author: Theon

plugins.name: Recall Cards
plugins.description: Turn a chosen idea into a question and practise recalling it.
plugins.details: Create question-and-answer cards for something you have chosen to learn. Try to answer before revealing, then move to the next card. Cards save in this plugin’s own browser storage. This is a practice aid, not a mastery score or spaced-repetition scheduler.
plugins.author: Theon
